title: Complete local source arrays earn a guarded count representation
statement: A finite n-site q-state CTMC has unary a[j,s,t] and pair-triggered b[i,j,r,s,t],i!=j,all nonnegative,with lambda_j(s->t|x)=a[j,s,t]+sum_i b[i,j,x_i,s,t]. Complete local arrays and unary/pair grammar are supplied to both methods. Conservative discovery accepts i<->j only when all incident native array entries are unchanged,then generates exchangeability classes;worst comparison work O(n^3 q^3),not maximal species equivalence. Count k_(g,s) has K=product_g binomial(|g|+q-1,q-1) states. Average native a,b over sites/ordered pairs of each retained group;compiled s->t rate is k_(g,s)[a_bar(g,s,t)+sum_(h,r)b_bar(h,g,r,s,t)(k_(h,r)-1_(h=g,r=s))]. Exact native swaps give ordinary exact CTMC lumping. Reusing an older orbit partition under heterogeneous new rates gives the uniform-orbit projected reference;the observed coarse microscopic process need not itself be Markovian. Unsupported named-site outputs must be refused or the named site split to a singleton and recompilation paid. The source-reported training/held-out q2/q3 fixtures numerically match exact references in exact cases;models/arrays are generated synthetic data. The algorithm,source grammar and generic compiler were engineered by the researcher;only the structural grouping/count generator is acquired from the supplied arrays. This is neither autonomous algorithm invention nor learning a scientific model language from raw observations.

requires: Finite CTMC with known nonnegative unary/pair local rate arrays and supplied scientific transition grammar. Learner and ordinary comparator receive and may retain the same arrays;group labels are withheld from the learner.

Quadratic approximation:initial law uniform within each occupied retained orbit,terminal payoff count invariant and in[0,1],explicit native deviation norms. Intervention schedules or augmented Markov feedback must be group equivariant.
provides: Exact statement above, at the stated contract.
costs: Acquire O(n^2 q^3) native coefficients;conservative O(n^3 q^3) swap comparison,enumeration,projection,training,failure/refinement,verification and storage charged. New physical rates and policy semantics still require acquisition.

Generic algorithm/grammar is an inherited researcher-written program. Source-reported wall times exclude separate development,physical rate measurement,actuation,energy and opportunity costs;no unique method or total-computation advantage inferred.
contract.units: CTMC physical/model time T differs from compute wall time. Full-source-model payoff probability,error halfwidth,representation state count and runtime are distinct. Synthetic SIS/SIRS fixtures are not biological observations.
contract.obstruction: Author-derived bounded synthetic pilot with source-reported tests,not independently whole-audited. Exchangeable preparation and count-invariant output are essential. Complete rate arrays/grammar and policy parameters are supplied;generic algorithms are researcher-engineered. No matched best near-lumping baseline,raw-observation acquisition,physical validation,practical advantage or novelty established.
